name: visual-case-sibling
goal: Match visual evidence to cases selected by each scenario check

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A scenario check requires screenshots for sibling cases from another check whenever their test file is shared.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing validation case used one case per file. It now exercises two declared cases and separate checks sharing the same file without increasing test count.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record 3ab93c51c3ec at 4ace444105 failed because sibling screenshots were requested by the wrong scenario check on harbor-mbp-2.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Limit visual requirements to the current scenario check references while retaining failures for unbound captures.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Record 9a700f1b111b at 31dda56c8f passed the unchanged case against red b479fcddfddb in the same laptop environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
